candidate.originalEvidence: src/legacy_doc.rs main_text (1148+) validates monotonic logical CP coverage but allows each piece to point at same physical WordDocument bytes; emits one StoryChar per logical CP without budget. A ~1 MiB repeated source region + small piece table can request billions of chars (u32 ccp_text), exhausting tens of GB.

candidate.originalEvidence: src/convert/metafile.rs 603-610 EXTTEXTOUT bounds text slice against whole data, not current record end off+size2; off advances size2 at690. Repeat 14-byte records (size=7 words, func0x0A32, y=x=opts=0,count=65535) followed by >=65535 bytes of padding. Each record copies next65535 bytes via ansi_text->String into texts Vec (431-440,692-700), yielding ~4GiB retained strings from ~1MiB WMF. No per-record or cumulative text bound; header canvas extents nonzero. decode_image (20248) calls render before image decode. Also polygon counts read across record boundary, amplifying CPU.
